Population increased in Uttlesford

The estimated population of Uttlesford in 2024 was 95,106 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

This meant that Uttlesford's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Uttlesford increased by 3.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Uttlesford was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Uttlesford

The average (median) age rose to 44.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Uttlesford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Uttlesford is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Uttlesford's population of 95,106 usual residents was made up of:

  • 18,150 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.1%)
  • 56,627 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.5%)
  • 20,329 people aged 65 years and over, (21.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Uttlesford has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (59.5% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Uttlesford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Uttlesford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Uttlesford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 56 people (0.1%). In total, there were 833 births and 777 deaths in Uttlesford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 831 (0.9%). There were 6,339 people entering the area and 5,508 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Uttlesford's population of 352 (0.4%) as a result of 609 people entering the area and 257 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Uttlesford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Uttlesford in mid-2023 is 93,910.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 227 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 89 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 316 people.
